overview_description.description:
Hive is a customer data and email platform used by thousands of brands to personalize and automate their marketing campaigns.

Our technology helps brands sell more stuff, while keeping their customers happy, engaged, and spending money.

We take billions of customer data points from platforms like Shopify, Mailchimp, Facebook, Instagram and more, infer as much knowledge as possible (using some really awesome technology), and then unify, organize, and segment customer profiles based on hundreds of attributes. Using these segments, brands are able to send personalized, automated emails to their customers - at scale.

product.name: Event Marketing Platform
product.description: A platform that integrates with ticketing systems to manage and execute targeted email and SMS marketing campaigns for live events.

product.name: Customer Relationship Management (CRM) for Events
product.description: A CRM system tailored for event promoters to consolidate ticket buyer data and create detailed customer profiles for targeted marketing.

product.name: Email Marketing Tool
product.description: An email marketing tool that uses ticketing data to create segmented, personalized campaigns for event promotion.

product.name: SMS Marketing Tool
product.description: A tool for sending personalized SMS campaigns to event attendees based on ticket buyer data and segmentation.

product.name: Marketing Reporting and Analytics
product.description: A reporting tool that links marketing campaigns to ticket sales, providing insights into campaign performance and revenue attribution.

product.name: Web Form Builder
product.description: A customizable web form and landing page builder to capture fan sign-ups and grow subscriber lists for event marketing.
